name: data-table
title: Data Table
description: A TanStack Table v9 data table with a filter sidebar (checkbox, input, slider and date range filters), sorting, column ordering and visibility, and a pluggable filter store.
label: data-table-filters
author: OpenStatus <https://github.com/openstatusHQ>

props.name: columns
props.description: TanStack Table v9 column definitions. `meta.headerClassName`, `meta.cellClassName` and `meta.label` are read by the table.

props.name: data
props.description: The rows. Filtering and sorting run on the client unless you fetch pages from a server.

props.name: filterFields
props.description: The sidebar filters: `checkbox`, `input`, `slider` (`min`, `max`, `unit`) or `timerange` (`presets`), each with `label`, `value` (the column id) and `defaultOpen`.

props.name: getRowId
props.description: A stable row id; the sheet and keyboard navigation use it.

props.name: getRowClassName
props.description: Extra classes per row. Keep the callback stable (useCallback).

props.name: totalRows / filterRows / totalRowsFetched
props.description: Server counts for the toolbar and the load-more row; omit them for client-side data.

props.name: fetchNextPage / hasNextPage / isFetching / isLoading
props.description: Paging: the table loads more on scroll and from the Load More button.

props.name: tableId
props.description: Namespace for the column order and visibility kept in localStorage.

props.name: commandSlot / sheetSlot / chartSlot / footerSlot / floatingBarSlot / toolbarActions
props.description: Places for the filter command, the row sheet, a chart, the sidebar footer, a selection bar and toolbar buttons.

a11y: Filters are an accordion of native buttons; checkbox filters are labeled checkboxes, and the "only" shortcut beside each option appears on keyboard focus as well as on hover.
The range filter has two labeled number inputs next to a slider whose thumbs move with the arrow keys.
Sortable headers are buttons; DataTableInfinite also sets aria-sort on each header cell.
Icon-only controls are named: the view options combobox ("View") and, below the sm breakpoint, the filter drawer button ("Toggle filters").
Rows in DataTableInfinite are focusable and Enter selects them; a collapsed filter panel is inert, so it leaves the tab order.
Shortcuts: Cmd or Ctrl + B toggles the filters, Cmd or Ctrl + Esc resets them, Cmd or Ctrl + U resets column order and visibility.
Under prefers-reduced-motion the accordion, panel width and spinner animations stop.
Right-to-left: layout uses logical properties; tooltips, the filter rail, the column resize handle and the slider mirror with dir="rtl" on <html>.
